title: Morning, wind
logline: One of the mornings, in wind: the flats with the water pushed into ridges, the grass on the dunes flat, the pup's ears back, the Legacy's tailgate down and the mug not on it because it would blow. The light still inside it.

panels.composition: Mudflats at low tide in a hard wind: the shallow water pushed into ridges, dune grass flattened, an old three-legged dog with its ears back, a station wagon's tailgate down with nothing on it. Light inside the gray.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, tidal mudflats at low tide in a hard wind with the shallow water pushed into ridges and dune grass flattened, an old three-legged dog with its ears back, a station wagon's open tailgate with nothing on it, luminous gray, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
